hypotheses.binder: (hsc : scatterFrom st.lab cnt st.cen[c]! (st.cen[c]! - c) c (Array.replicate (st.cen[c]! - c) 0) bc1 = (block, bc2))
hypotheses.justification: The definition of splitCell shows that neither scatterFrom nor writeFrom affects the trace or the inputs to boundsFrom. Destructure their actual outputs and apply splitCell_eq_general using those equations, together with hb, h1, h2, ho and hbd; projecting .tr proves the conclusion without hsc or hw. This works for empty arrays and zero fuel as well. Both hypotheses can be deleted simultaneously.

hypotheses.binder: (hw : writeFrom block c block.size 0 st.lab st.pos = (lab, pos))
hypotheses.justification: Destructure the actual result of writeFrom and supply its equation instead of hw to splitCell_eq_general. Its lab and pos outputs disappear upon projecting .tr, leaving the desired equality. No nonemptiness or index-validity assumptions are needed, including for empty blocks. This hypothesis can also be deleted together with hsc.
